notes: Addressed to «صاحب السمو الملكي أمير منطقة الرياض حفظه الله», asking him to direct the competent body. Sewage overflow in front of a primary school in حي النسيم, مدينة الرياض, for two weeks; 600+ pupils and a kindergarten walk through it daily. Vulnerable group + health risk + community impact = high. Not critical: no direct threat to life. Rule signals health_risk and vulnerable_person only floor to medium, so 'high' must come from the model. First submission; #10 is its follow-up. Digits are Arabic-Indic throughout (ID ١٠٩٨٧٦٥٤٣٢).

Addressed to the Prince of Riyadh Region. ER misdiagnosis at مستشفى الخرج العام of appendicitis as gastroenteritis; the 7-year-old is STILL in paediatric ICU and the mother asks for urgent intervention/transfer, so the risk to life is direct and ongoing = critical. Borderline with high only if read as a retrospective error report; the ongoing ICU stay tips it. Rules can floor only to medium here (vulnerable_person via 'الأطفال'); rules never set critical, so this tests the model. The hospital is the party complained against, not the addressee.

The Emirate's own table-style form «نموذج تقديم شكوى — إمارة منطقة الرياض»; its addressee row reads «إمارة منطقة الرياض – إدارة الشكاوى» and the office box leaves «الإحالة إلى» blank for the desk. Four months of unpaid wages (7,200 SAR) on a site in حي السلي, مدينة الرياض, expired iqama, about 15 co-workers in the same situation: significant harm to livelihood + wider impact = high. The ID is an iqama number (starts with 2) under the label «رقم الهوية الوطنية / الإقامة». Checkboxes (☑/☐) test that only the ticked complaint type is used. No rule signals.

Addressed to «سعادة وكيل إمارة منطقة الرياض المحترم». Unrepaired pothole after utility works in حي الفيصلية, المجمعة damaged tyres and a rim (1,260 SAR); neighbours report similar damage. A service problem with financial damage and no stated danger to life = medium. Borderline high if read as a road-safety hazard (unmarked, poorly lit); the text describes damage, not injury. No rule signals.

Addressed to the Prince of Riyadh Region. Café in حي العودة, الدرعية open until ~4 a.m. with loud music and car horns; the complainant explicitly does not want it closed. A nuisance (إزعاج) = low. Borderline medium because it recurs nightly and affects several neighbours' sleep; medium is a defensible model answer. No rule signals, so a model answer of low stays low. Shortest sample (~180 words).

Addressed to the Prince of Riyadh Region, with a copy (نسخة) to the Ministry of Energy: the cc line is not the addressee, so addressed_to_entity stays true. Outages 3-4 times a day in حي العزيزية, الزلفي while an 81-year-old father with COPD depends on a home oxygen concentrator; he already needed the ER during the last outage. Direct threat to life = critical; high is the defensible neighbour (the high definition names vulnerable persons and essential-service outages). Rule signals vulnerable_person (مسن، جهاز أكسجين) and service_outage floor to medium; critical must come from the model. Dates written out with month names (ربيع الآخر / سبتمبر), Arabic-Indic digits.

E-mail printout «إلى: إدارة الشكاوى – إمارة منطقة الرياض <complaints@example.com>» (Arabic من/إلى/الموضوع headers, Latin addresses, one quoted English auto-reply line); the body asks for the complaint to be referred to the competent body. Undelivered order and no refund, 2,450 SAR, individual financial harm = medium. Subcategory commercial_fraud is also acceptable. Region/governorate come from the signature (الرياض – حي الملقا); 'unknown' is acceptable if the city is missed.

Addressed to «سعادة وكيل إمارة منطقة الرياض المحترم». Repeated bullying of a middle-school pupil (المتوسطة الثالثة, حي الروضة, الدوادمي) escalating to a documented physical assault, with the school taking no action and the child refusing to attend: a minor's safety = high. Not critical: no ongoing threat to life. No rule signals match (the text says «سلامته», not «يهدد سلامة»). Mixed digits: Arabic-Indic Hijri date and mobile, Western Gregorian date and ID.

Addressed to the Prince of Riyadh Region. Monthly package fee billed twice on two invoices (378 SAR excess) for a home in وادي الدواسر; the service itself works and a ticket is already open with the provider. Expected priority changed from low to medium: an overcharge that the provider failed to correct is a service problem with financial harm, which is the medium definition («مشكلة خدمية تحتاج معالجة دون خطر مباشر»), not a minor inconvenience or an improvement note. Low stays defensible because the amount is small and individual. Contains a small bills table. No rule signals.

Second submission (للمرة الثانية) of #1 to the Prince of Riyadh Region: same name and national ID, but written here in Western digits (1098765432) while #1 uses Arabic-Indic, so repeat detection must normalise digits. References #1's date and incoming number 47812. The problem has worsened after a month = high (not critical). Expected: signal repeated_unresolved, repeat_count >= 1 and review reason repeat_complainant once #1 is stored (the reason is absent if #10 is processed alone). Other signals: health_risk, vulnerable_person.

IMAGE-ONLY PDF (150 dpi grey scan, slight skew, noise, JPEG): no text layer, so only OCR can read it. Addressed to «سعادة وكيل إمارة منطقة الرياض المحترم». Housing support (100,000 SAR) for a unit in حي السلام, شقراء not deposited for about three months; a household of six paying rent plus the loan instalment. Financial harm with no immediate danger = medium. The body names the Ministry of Municipalities and Housing branch the complainant visited. A tilted «الوارد» received stamp sits in the top-left corner. No rule signals.

NOT a complaint: a thank-you letter to the Prince of Riyadh Region praising the orthopaedics team of مستشفى الربوة العام in مدينة الرياض and asking the Emirate to pass the thanks on (the hospital director is only copied). null = any category/ministry is accepted (health_services/health is the natural guess). Must end with needs_review = true and review reason not_a_complaint. Contains no rule-signal phrases, so the priority should stay low.

OUTSIDE JURISDICTION: addressed to the Prince of Riyadh Region, but the complainant lives in and writes about جدة (makkah region): an underpass in حي الصفا fills with rain water because its drainage pumps have not worked for over a year; at the last rain three cars stalled inside and a family was pulled out by passers-by (no injuries); the underpass stayed closed four days. Region makkah ≠ the Emirate's region, so governorate must be unknown and review reason outside_jurisdiction must be present; the acknowledgment should say the complaint will be forwarded to the competent region's emirate. City underpasses and rain drainage belong to the municipality: municipal_services / municipal; transport (road_safety_design) with ministry municipal is also acceptable. Priority medium-high: a recurring hazard on a route used by thousands = high; medium is defensible because nobody was hurt and it is not raining now. Written without rule-signal phrases (no «غرق», no «أطفال»), so the priority is the model's. Arabic-Indic digits.

OUTSIDE JURISDICTION, SENDER IN RIYADH (harder than #13, where sender and problem are both in Jeddah). Addressed to the Prince of Riyadh Region by a father who lives in مدينة الرياض: the sender box says «مدينة الرياض – حي العارض», and the letter opens «بصفتي مواطناً من سكان مدينة الرياض». The complaint is about the children's play area of a public park in حي الحوية, محافظة الطائف (makkah region), which the family visited in late August. The big slide is broken, with a sharp metal edge; a swing chain has snapped and is tied with rope; a platform about 2 m high has no side rail; bolts stick out and the rubber flooring is torn over hard tiles. The 6-year-old son cut his hand (two stitches). Dozens of children use the equipment every evening, and there is no warning sign or barrier. A 940 report got no answer. The problem's place decides: region makkah, governorate unknown, review reason outside_jurisdiction. A pipeline that takes the sender's address will wrongly answer riyadh/riyadh_city and miss the flag. Parks and their equipment belong to the municipality: municipal_services/public_parks/municipal. Priority high: an injury has already happened, and many children remain exposed to it every day. medium is defensible, because the injury was minor and nobody is in immediate danger of death. Rule signal vulnerable_person («الأطفال», «طفل») floors to medium only, so high must come from the model. Western digits.
